title: Legal PA
description:
Legal PA

Guildford

33,000

Our client is seeking a Legal PA to join their well-established law firm's busy Dispute Resolution team. Ideally, you will have previous contentious or litigation experience and be confident providing proactive support to Partners and fee earners.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage busy diaries, meetings, and appointments.
- Oversee inboxes, emails, and correspondence.
- Prepare and format legal documents and correspondence.
- Maintain electronic and paper filing systems.
- Assist with the progression of client matters.
- Provide administrative support to Partners and fee earners.
- Liaise professionally with clients and external contacts.
- Operate case management systems and support the smooth running of the department.

Requirements
- Minimum 5 years' experience working within a law firm.
- Previous Legal PA, Legal Secretary or Legal Admin experience.
- Experience within Dispute Resolution, Litigation, or contentious work.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Fast, accurate typing and strong IT skills.
- Proactive approach, confident communication skills, and the ability to work under pressure.

title: Paralegal (Property and Private Client)
description:
Our client is a well-established law firm seeking a Property & Private Client Paralegal to join their team. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated legal professional to work across a broad range of property and private client matters, while developing their legal knowledge and practical experience.

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the progression of legal matters, maintaining client relationships and ensuring files are managed efficiently and accurately throughout the lifecycle of each case.

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting solicitors and fee earners on a range of property and private client matters.
- Preparing, reviewing and managing legal documents, correspondence and client communications.
- Assisting with property transactions from instruction through to completion.
- Supporting the preparation of wills, powers of attorney, probate applications and estate administration documentation.
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders, local authorities and other third parties.
- Conducting legal research and preparing supporting documentation where required.
- Managing client onboarding processes and ensuring compliance requirements are met.
- Maintaining accurate file management, document control and case records.
- Managing diaries, appointments and meeting arrangements.
- Assisting with billing, file administration and general legal support duties.

Experience and Skills Requirements
- Previous experience within a Property, Private Client or Legal Support role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- High attention to detail and strong administrative capabilities.
- Professional and client-focused approach.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Strong legal research and document drafting skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted
